keyboard.action: Activates the button on key up

keyboard.when: a disabled button is skipped; a busy or disabled-with-reason (tooltip) button is a tab stop

keyboard.action: Activates the form's default submit button from a field
keyboard.when: type=submit is the first submit button of the form

form.notes: type=submit: temporary hidden native submitter carrying name/value and the form* overrides, then requestSubmit(temp) (A§9.7); type=reset: form.reset(). SubmitEvent.submitter is that temporary button. Enter in a field activates the first submit button; disabled/busy buttons do nothing. `form=` and <fieldset disabled> work natively. No form value of its own.

differences.text: The click event is the native event from the inner button. The default action (submit, reset, clickAction) runs after the event finished dispatching, so a listener on the host can preventDefault() and cancel it, like a native button; upstream's onClick ran before clickAction. `SubmitEvent.submitter` is a temporary native button, not the host (platform limit, A§20 item 6).

A busy button (loading or pending clickAction) uses aria-disabled + an activation guard instead of native `disabled`, so keyboard focus is never dropped to the body; upstream disables the native button. Announcement is a single polite message through the announcer instead of a per-button role=status region.
A link-rendering button (href) stays an <a> while busy (guarded), instead of flipping to a <button> and losing focus; only an explicitly disabled button renders as <button>.

Variants paint from Tecton action roles; `outlined` and `text-only` are added (owner's theme). `destructive` is bound to --tecton-color-status-error-* (D-013 Q-06). Focus is the hover fill plus the hot-pink ring on every variant, destructive included (D-005), 1px from the edge (--button-focus-offset). Disabled is a recessed fill, not opacity 0.5. Every edge has a transparent 1px border so forced colours can paint it.
`href` + `as` component: routers integrate through linkContext `navigate(href, event)`; `as` is waived. An href refused by the URL policy (javascript:) renders a button.
Icon: attribute `icon` (registered name) and slots `icon` / `end` replace the ReactNode props icon / endContent; the default slot replaces children, with `label` as the fallback visible text.

core.button.notes: Guides: [mwg:form-associated-custom-elements] FACE, submitter and reset; [mwg:accessible-web-components] delegation of aria-* to the inner control and states through aria-disabled; [mwg:css] focus-visible ring, touch targets, forced colours, reduced motion; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts, ::slotted icons, host layout only; [mwg:interest-triggered-tooltips] and [mwg:position-aware-tooltips] the built-in tooltip; [mwg:shadow-dom] slots and delegatesFocus; [mwg:custom-elements] lifecycle and custom states.
